user.title: Radar Zone Presence
user.description: Sets up your home. Radars and zones are then added as parts of it: the first radar right away, more with Add radar on the integration page.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Radar Zone Presence is already set up. Add radars and zones from its integration page.

user.title: Pick a radar sensor
user.description: Devices that expose per-target X/Y coordinate sensors (Everything Presence Lite/Pro, Screek 2A, other LD2450 firmwares). Area, floor and the number of targets each radar sees right now are shown to tell them apart (walk in front of one and reopen to check). Zones are drawn afterwards in the Radar Zones panel.

import_legacy.title: Import existing polygons
import_legacy.description: Found {count} polygon helper(s) (input_text.…_zone_polygon_N) for this sensor. Import them as zones? The helpers are not changed or removed.

abort.no_devices: No unconfigured radar sensors with per-target X/Y entities were found.

user.title: Add a presence zone
user.description: Creates a presence device for a spot or room. It starts as a 1 × 1 m square in front of the radar; draw its real shape in the Radar Zones panel.

data_description.area_id: Leave empty to use the radar's area.

reconfigure.title: Zone
reconfigure.description: Shape, filters and hold settings are edited in the Radar Zones panel.

data_description.area_id: Leave empty to use the radar's area.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Zones, exclusions, exits and per-zone filters are edited in the Radar Zones panel in the sidebar.

data.outside_doors: Doors to outside no radar sees
data.evidence_on: Signs of someone there (switched on only)

data_description.reconnect_grace_s: Seconds to ignore a radar's detections after it comes back from unavailable. Ghost targets often appear right after a reconnect.
data_description.outside_doors: Doors, garage doors and locks to outside that no radar watches (a garage door: its area becomes a space without a radar). Used by the head count; doors on exit zones are picked up from the zones.
data_description.evidence: Switches, lights, buttons and door contacts (closets, inner doors) that mean someone is in their area when used. Only changes made by hand count: not by automations, scripts or the app. Used by the head count, for rooms without a radar and for people who sit still.
data_description.evidence_on: Like the above, but only switching on counts: for things a timer or the device itself turns off (a fan on a timer).
data_description.vacuums: A robot vacuum moves like a person to a radar. While one is cleaning, the head count ignores the radars in the room it reports (its current room sensor, matched to an area by name).
